attendance_policy: Regularity in attendance will be one of the criteria in deciding the borderline cases at the time of final grading as well as make-up's.
makeup_policy: Make-Ups are not given as a routine. It is solely dependent upon the genuineness of the circumstances under which a student fails to appear in a scheduled evaluation component. In such circumstances, prior permission should be obtained from the Instructor-in-Charge. The decision of the Instructor-in-Charge in the above matter will be final. There is no makeup for continuous evaluation.
